note: Hand-kept backcountry ski routes that no open data source has (alex 2026-11-03: Joffre Shoulder). One file per province (bc: the Duffey classics Joffre Shoulder, Chief Pascall and Cayoosh, the Sea to Sky Gondola's approaches, the Powder Mountain Snowmobile Club's Brandywine / Powder Mountain sled trails from the club's KMZ, alex 2026-11-08); add a route to its file and widen that file's box here. Each route has src "hand", tags hand:* (shown in plain words in winter.js PLAIN) and links [{t,u}]. approx = drawn from the terrain model, not a GPS track. patch: tags, name and links added to OpenStreetMap routes by id (the gondola's groomed Backcountry Access Road). "hand:classic" marks a classic tour (the Duffey Lake Road ones, alex 2026-11-04): Ask lists classics first; "hand:aka" is other names it is searched by (Kayoosh). "hand:cls" is the avalanche terrain class (1 Simple, 2 Challenging, 3 Complex) read from the guidebooks and trip reports, for Ask's "simple tour" until the nightly terrain file has the route; the Duffey day tours from Keith's Hut (Anniversary Glacier, Vantage Peak) added 2026-11-06 when Ask found nothing for "the duffys". "way": true marks a documented way up (the skin track and bootpack everyone uses, alex 2026-11-05: Phalanx via the Stairmaster): the Safest way follows it when a leg goes from near its start to near its top (ski-route.js wayOf). "official" + "wb": Whistler Blackcomb's own uphill and backcountry access routes (their terrain status map's ArcGIS layers Backcountry_Access and Early_Season_Uphill_Access, copied 2026-11-05; the card reads today's status live by the "wb" name). patch can also hold g (a line redrawn from a GPS track) and way. nogo: lines the Safest way never crosses, about 30 m wide, where the terrain model looks easy but isn't (Phalanx's pinnacled south ridge).
